messages.text:
Not sure why my NerdMQaxe++
Will not work?
Searched the web · pool.harlolabs.com stratum port NerdQaxe
Searched the web · harlolabs.com Harlo OS NerdQaxe++ latest version

Hi Bill,

Thanks for sticking with this. Since your other miners are already hashing on Harlo Pool from the same network, the pool and your internet are working. Something in this one miner's settings is different, so here are the most likely causes, quickest first.

First, check the worker field. Harlo Pool mines Bitcoin Cash. The worker has to be your BCH wallet address and the password should be just x. If this miner still has a Bitcoin address in the worker field, or something left over from another pool, it can connect without any of its shares being counted. The quickest fix is to open the pool settings on one of your working NerdQAxe++ units and copy the URL, port, worker and password into this one exactly as they are. Save, restart the miner and give it about 10 minutes.

Second, if it still isn't sending shares, look at its dashboard. Note how many shares are accepted and rejected, and whether it says it is connected to the primary pool or a fallback pool. If there is a fallback pool, it may be mining there instead of on Harlo.

Third, check the firmware. In its settings or system page, see whether it runs NerdOS or Harlo OS and which version. If it is behind the others, update it from the flasher at harlolabs.com in Chrome or Edge.

If none of that fixes it, please reply with:
1. Which unit this is. Is it a third NerdQAxe++ or a different model?
2. The firmware name and version.
3. A screenshot of its dashboard showing the share counts and pool status.
4. A screenshot of its pool settings page. The worker name is fine to show, but please don't include any account passwords.

With those I can tell you exactly where it's getting stuck.

Hal, HeliumDeploy
